bullets: Replaced Frizzle's manual worksheet-grading setup and configuration with a conversational AI chat, allowing teachers to describe grading requirements in natural language while AI agents automatically configure grading settings and evaluate worksheets.
Redesigned the platform's UI and developed internal tools to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve team efficiency.
Built the production backend for Sparkeefy's AI relationship wellness app ahead of its V3 Play Store launch, including Supabase authentication and GCP Cloud Run deployment.
Built the Wingman AI chat backend with session handling, guardrails, and OpenRouter/DeepSeek LLM integration; shipped performance improvements.
Implemented phone OTP authentication, user entitlements, rate limiting, and security fixes; built 2 internal tools (Admin Panel, Wingman Lab) for testing and QA.
Contributing to Reticle, an open-source AI verification platform that uses live DOM, network, and routing signals from running web apps.
Merged a 4,500+ LOC, 46-file dev HUD redesign and a bridge reliability fix that prevents false success states; improved assertion grammar for agent workflows.

Built a meeting-transcription Chrome extension with a real-time audio capture and WebSocket streaming pipeline, delivering speech-to-text at sub-1-second latency for 100+ concurrent sessions; processed 50+ hours of test recordings.
Designed responsive live-caption and transcript-management interfaces, reducing transcript retrieval time by 80%.
